**Finding submitted — deviation (AUDIT).**

- **Responsive clauses:** Article IV(b) (p0073) is the only audit right binding us; the audit-cost allocation sits separately at p0064. No system-access, monitoring or inspection right appears elsewhere in the document.
- **Why it fails fallback:** frequency is unlimited, and the "within 30 days of receipt of a written request" language is a deadline for us to permit the audit, not advance notice — so neither the once-per-year nor the 15-day notice fallback element is met (unlimited audits are walk-away territory).
- **Already met (not re-drafted):** independent CPA/Audit Professional as auditor, and Licensor-borne cost unless a discrepancy exceeding 5% is found (preferred cost threshold).
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace capping audits at once per 12-month period on at least 30 days' prior written notice, plus one short inserted sentence adding business hours, off-site where possible, auditor confidentiality and no direct access to our systems. All unrelated text preserved.
